create.title: Create new configuration

unsaved.title: Unsaved Changes
unsaved.message: You have unsaved changes. If you continue, they will be lost.

deleteFile.title: Delete configuration
deleteFile.message: Delete {{name}} from the server? This cannot be undone. Download it first if you want to keep a copy.

disableFile.title: Disable configuration
disableFile.message: Disable {{name}}? Disabling some configurations can make the interface stop responding.

markAsDefault.title: Mark as default configuration
markAsDefault.message: Add the '# default configuration' header to {{name}}? Jahia will then preserve local changes for this module-provided default.

addItem.message: Enter item value (keep empty for complex structure):

editor.rawEditorLabelFor: Configuration source of {{name}}. Press Ctrl+M (Ctrl+Shift+M on macOS) to make Tab leave the editor.

tooltip.module: Module-managed configuration. Local edits may be overwritten on restart or redeploy.
tooltip.moduleDefault: Module default configuration. Jahia preserves local changes.

banner.module: This module-managed configuration may be overwritten on restart or redeploy. Local edits are not guaranteed to persist.
banner.moduleDefault: This module default configuration is editable. Jahia preserves local changes.

tooltip.uploadFile: Import a configuration file (.cfg, .yml) or an export archive (.ocmx)
tooltip.discardChanges: Discard your edits and reload the saved version
tooltip.markAsDefault: Add the '# default configuration' header so Jahia preserves local changes for module defaults
tooltip.addMetatypeProperty: Open the list of available properties for this PID
tooltip.addMetatypePropertyDisabled: No Metatype metadata is available for this file
tooltip.encryptSelection: Encrypt the value of the line where the cursor is
tooltip.decryptSelection: Decrypt the ENC(...) value of the line where the cursor is
tooltip.toggleComments: Show or hide the comments. The header comment always stays visible.
tooltip.toggleEmptyLines: Show or hide the empty lines. Those of the header always stay visible.
tooltip.showSecrets: Show the values of the secrets of this file. They are masked again when another file is opened. Masking is visual only: screen readers still read the values.
tooltip.hideSecrets: Mask the values of the secrets
tooltip.tabMovesFocus: When on, Tab moves the focus out of the editor instead of indenting. Ctrl+M toggles it too (Ctrl+Shift+M on macOS).
tooltip.hideMetatypeProperties: Close the list of available properties
tooltip.markAsDefaultAlready: Unavailable: this configuration is already a module default
tooltip.markAsDefaultModule: Unavailable: only a local configuration (User) can be marked as default
tooltip.exportArchive: Export several files into one password-protected archive

bundleUsage.title: Used by
bundleUsage.loading: Looking for the bundles that use this configuration…
bundleUsage.empty: No bundle detected. A bundle may still read this configuration in a way the manager cannot see.
bundleUsage.error: Could not list the bundles that use this configuration.

export.title: Export configurations
export.intro: Choose the files to export. They are saved in one archive protected by a password. Encrypted values are decrypted in the archive: anyone with the password can read them. Keep the password safe. The manager’s own configuration is never exported.
export.undecryptable: {{name}}: {{count}} encrypted value(s) could not be decrypted here. They stay encrypted in the archive and will not decrypt on another instance.

password.label: Password
password.hint: At least {{count}} characters. It is needed to import the archive and cannot be recovered.
password.errorTooShort: The password needs at least {{count}} characters.
password.errorMismatch: The passwords do not match. Type the same password in both fields.
password.errorEmpty: Enter the password of this archive.

import.title: Import an archive
import.intro: Archive: {{fileName}}. Enter the password it was exported with to see what it contains. Nothing is written before you confirm.
import.toEncrypt: Secrets stored in readable form, to encrypt now in the editor:

preview.jahiaUnknown: The Jahia version of the archive or of this instance is unknown.
preview.informational: These notes are for information. They do not stop the import.
preview.versionSame: Archive: {{archiveVersion}}. Installed here: the same version.
preview.versionOlder: Archive: {{archiveVersion}}. Installed here: {{targetVersion}}, older than the archive.
preview.versionNewer: Archive: {{archiveVersion}}. Installed here: {{targetVersion}}, newer than the archive.
preview.versionAbsent: Archive: {{archiveVersion}}. No bundle of that name uses or describes this configuration here.
preview.notRunning: This bundle is installed here but not running.
preview.ownerless: No bundle used this configuration on the server it comes from.
preview.bundlesUnknown: The archive does not say which bundles use this configuration.
preview.unknownKeys: Settings the version installed here does not know: {{keys}}. They will probably be ignored.
preview.keysNotChecked: The versions differ, and the settings could not be checked: this server has no description of them.
preview.sameConfiguration: Another file here, {{files}}, configures the same thing. Both would apply.
preview.secrets: Encrypted values that will be encrypted again with this server’s key: {{count}}.
preview.undecryptable: Encrypted values the original server could not read, and that cannot be read here either: {{count}}. Enter them again after the import.
preview.clearSecrets: Secrets stored in readable form: {{keys}}. Encrypt them after the import.
preview.replaces: Overwrites the file of the same name here: its current content is lost.
preview.refusedName: Cannot be imported: the file name is not valid.
preview.refusedManager: Cannot be imported: the manager’s own configuration is never imported.
preview.refusedPermission: Cannot be imported: you are not permitted to write this file here.
